title: _Drosophila_ Schneider 2 \(S2) cell culture
protocol: Seed S2 cells at a concentration of 1 x 10^6 cells/ml in 100 x 20 mm tissue culture plates using 10 ml of conditioned medium supplemented with 25% of the original growth medium.
Incubate the seeded cells in a 28°C incubator without CO2 requirements.
Split cells at a dilution ratio of 1:2 to 1:5 when cell density reaches between 6 to 20 x 10^6 cells/ml.
Pretreat S2 cells with 1 microM 20-hydroxy-ecdysone for 24 hours if planning to perform LPS or PGN stimulation.
